WHEN MATCHED THEN
UPDATE SET
PENSN_GIVE_STTS_BGNG_YM = REPLACE(#{PENSN_GIVE_STTS_BGNG_YM},'-',''),
MM_PENSN_GIVE_AMT = #{MM_PENSN_GIVE_AMT},
PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO = #{PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO},

STTS_OCRN_CS_CN = #{STTS_OCRN_CS_CN},

PIC_INST_NO = #{PIC_INST_NO},
PIC_TELNO = REPLACE(#{PIC_TELNO}, '-', ''),
TASKWK_OCRN_SQNCE = #{TASKWK_OCRN_SQNCE},

mapper.select: SELECT /* 신규(WHEN)일 경우 1, (ELSE) 추가 등록의 경우, 기존 지급일자 정렬 순번 최대 값 + 1 */ CASE WHEN (MAX(TASKWK_OCRN_SQNCE) + 1) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE (MAX(TASKWK_OCRN_SQNCE) + 1) END TASKWK_OCRN_SQNCE FROM AEB131 WHERE RECIPI_MNG_NO = #{RECIPI_MNG_NO} AND PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD = REPLACE(#{PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD},'-','')
mapper.sql:
WITH CHG_TBL AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD,A.TASKWK_OCRN_SQNCE) AS RNO , A.* FROM AEB131 A WHERE A.RECIPI_MNG_NO = #{RECIPI_MNG_NO} AND A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD = '02' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' ) , A_TBL AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD <= B.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD THEN B.RNO ELSE 999999 END A_NO , CASE WHEN A.PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD = '02' THEN 9 ELSE 1 END B_NO , A.* FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT B.PIC_INST_NO AS INST_NO , D.* FROM SEB100 A , SEB150 B , AEB130 C , AEB131 D WHERE A.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND A.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO AND C.RECIPI_MNG_NO = #{RECIPI_MNG_NO} AND C.RECIPI_MNG_NO = D.RECIPI_MNG_NO AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' ) A , CHG_TBL B WHERE A.RECIPI_MNG_NO = B.RECIPI_MNG_NO(+) AND A.PENSN_GIVE_CHG_BFE_LCGOV_NO = B.PENSN_GIVE_CHG_BFE_LCGOV_NO(+) ) , B_TBL AS ( SELECT * FROM A_TBL WHERE 1=1
AND INST_NO IN ( SELECT INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD IN ('U01','U04') START WITH INST_NO IN ( SELECT INST_NO FROM SAB230 WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID2} UNION SELECT INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE 1=1 AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND RGN_CD IN ( SELECT B.RGN_CD FROM SAB230 A , SAA000 B WHERE A.USER_ID = #{USER_ID2} AND A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U05' ) ) CONNECT BY UP_INST_NO = PRIOR INST_NO )
UNION SELECT * FROM A_TBL WHERE 1=1
AND PENSN_GIVE_CHG_BFE_LCGOV_NO IN ( SELECT INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD IN ('U01','U04') START WITH INST_NO IN ( SELECT INST_NO FROM SAB230 WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID2} UNION SELECT INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE 1=1 AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND RGN_CD IN ( SELECT B.RGN_CD FROM SAB230 A, SAA000 B WHERE A.USER_ID = #{USER_ID2} AND A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U05' ) ) CONNECT BY UP_INST_NO = PRIOR INST_NO )
UNION SELECT * FROM A_TBL WHERE 1=1
AND PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO IN ( SELECT INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD IN ('U01','U04') START WITH INST_NO IN ( SELECT INST_NO FROM SAB230 WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID2} UNION SELECT INST_NO FROM SAA000 WHERE 1=1 AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U04' AND RGN_CD IN ( SELECT B.RGN_CD FROM SAB230 A , SAA000 B WHERE A.USER_ID = #{USER_ID2} AND A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U05' ) ) CONNECT BY UP_INST_NO = PRIOR INST_NO )
) , MAX_DT_TBL AS ( SELECT MAX(PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD) AS MAX_DT FROM B_TBL ) , AEB131TMP AS ( SELECT DISTINCT A_NO , B_NO , TASKWK_OCRN_SQNCE , PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD , RCMDTN_SHELTR_NO , RCMDTN_YMD , PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD , PENSN_GIVE_STTS_BGNG_YM , MM_PENSN_GIVE_AMT , PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO , PENSN_GIVE_CHG_BFE_LCGOV_NO , STTS_OCRN_CS_SE_CD , STTS_OCRN_CS_CN , RECIPI_MNG_NO , PIC_ENFSN_NO , PIC_INST_NO , PIC_TELNO , FRST_REG_DT , DEL_YN FROM A_TBL WHERE PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD < ( SELECT MAX_DT FROM MAX_DT_TBL ) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT A_NO , B_NO , TASKWK_OCRN_SQNCE , PENSN_GIVE_STTS_SE_CD , RCMDTN_SHELTR_NO , RCMDTN_YMD , PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD , PENSN_GIVE_STTS_BGNG_YM , MM_PENSN_GIVE_AMT , PENSN_GIVE_CHG_LCGOV_NO , PENSN_GIVE_CHG_BFE_LCGOV_NO , STTS_OCRN_CS_SE_CD , STTS_OCRN_CS_CN , RECIPI_MNG_NO , PIC_ENFSN_NO , PIC_INST_NO , PIC_TELNO , FRST_REG_DT , DEL_YN FROM B_TBL WHERE PENSN_GIVE_STTS_OCRN_YMD = ( SELECT MAX_DT FROM MAX_DT_TBL ) )
